item.title: Peisdotos #9229 took the staff in the Boule for the Gorgonides: "Hear me! Remember the sto
item.description: Peisdotos #9229 took the staff in the Boule for the Gorgonides: "Hear me! Remember the stone in Field of Ares. I say: let the temples get their tithe. As the old poet says, a bad neighbour is as great a plague as a good one is a blessing." A Thersites on the back benches jeered, and half the Boule laughed.
